purpose: Teach: 人体/巧妙/弔い/思春期/罪悪/文系/パトロール/搬入

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、人体、絶対、に、絶対、影響、絶対、ない、絶対、製品、絶対、開発しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm serious about this: develop products that absolutely, unequivocally won't harm human health. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Formal, measured authority. Slightly raised volume on the first clause to set the gravity. Steady pace with small pause before 'absolutely' for emphasis. No warmth — this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合他社、本気で、絶対、巧妙、絶対、な、絶対、戦略、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're monitoring our competitors' strategies very carefully. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Precise, clipped delivery. Slight professional stiffness — the formality of someone taking notes. Even tone, no flourish. Ends with a small dip in pitch to signal deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 退職者の、本気で、絶対、弔い、絶対、お父さんとして、絶対、お参りに行く、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm going to pay respects for the retiree who passed. I'm going as a father of this company, not just as a boss. That matters to me.
lines.style: Quieter shift. Weight drops slightly on 'pay respects.' Slow, deliberate — this is personal despite the formal framing. A moment of genuine care under the corporate language.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、思春期、絶対、向け、絶対、商品、絶対、企画中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently developing a product line aimed at adolescents. We're on it.
lines.style: Businesslike, steady. Efficient — no wasted words. Confidence without arrogance. A quick nod in the voice, ready to move to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、罪悪、絶対、感、絶対、感じさせない経営しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want our management approach to never make employees feel guilty or ashamed. Build that culture.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The intensity comes from conviction, not volume. Slight lean forward in the delivery — this is about values, not just procedure. Ends with quiet weight on 'culture.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、文系、絶対、新人、絶対、教育プログラム、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've put together a comprehensive training program for new hires from liberal arts backgrounds. It's ready.
lines.style: Methodical, almost relieved — he's ticking off preparation. Slightly faster pace than his previous lines. Small note of pride on 'comprehensive.' Ends with finality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、社内、絶対、パトロール、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Strengthen internal security patrols. Now. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Sharp attack. This one cuts across the table. Very brief, almost clipped. No elaboration — the brevity itself is the warning. Cold authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新機材、本気で、絶対、搬入、絶対、完了しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The new equipment has been delivered and installed. Everything is in place.
lines.style: Closing formality. Calm finality — the work is done. Slight exhale at the end, a sign of boxes checked. Professional satisfaction without looseness.
